# Country scope. Playable Poland-Lithuania Intermarium host gate (Slot 77).
oe_pplc_is_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		tag = POL
		tag = LIT
		tag = PLC
	}
}

# Any scope. At least one Poland-Lithuania host tag exists.
oe_pplc_any_alive = {
	OR = {
		country_exists = c:PLC
		country_exists = c:POL
		country_exists = c:LIT
	}
}

	OR = {

			country_exists = c:BYZ
			is_allied_with = { target = c:BYZ }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Liberum Veto status helpers (null-safe).
oe_pplc_veto_crisis_active = {
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished }
	has_variable = oe_pplc_sejm_veto
	var:oe_pplc_sejm_veto >= 65
}

oe_pplc_veto_tamed = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished
		AND = {
			has_variable = oe_pplc_sejm_veto
			var:oe_pplc_sejm_veto <= 20
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Read-only interoperability readers on Slot 49 (oe_plc_) to prevent Krewo/Grunwald/Lublin double-fire.
oe_pplc_slot49_grunwald_done = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_grunwald_state }
		global_var:oe_plc_grunwald_state >= 1
	}
	trigger_else = {
		always = no
	}
}

oe_pplc_slot49_lublin_done = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_lublin_state }
		global_var:oe_plc_lublin_state >= 1
	}
	trigger_else = {
		always = no
	}
}
